description_en: Provides a server-side-only API for the eKYC solution
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl ekyc-verify-v2 --product-code eKYC_MIN --merchant-biz-id e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c353888 --merchant-user-id 123456 --doc-type 00000001 --doc-name '张00' --doc-no 410000000000000000 --id-ocr-picture-url https://digital-cardocr-prod8.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/1669520556530-expo/default/face/20221127114236530_w3kx2e6t.jpg --id-ocr-picture-base64 base64 --id-ocr-picture-file InputStream --face-picture-url https://digital-face-prod8.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/1669520556530-expo/default/face/20221127114236530_w3kx2e6t.jpg --face-picture-base64 Base64 --face-picture-file InputStream --crop F --authorize T --id-threshold 0 --face-quality-check Y --region cn-hangzhou
name: EkycVerifyV2

parameters.help_en: A custom business unique identifier defined by the merchant, used for subsequent issue tracking and troubleshooting. Supports a combination of letters and numbers up to 32 characters in length. Ensure that this value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持长度为 32 位的字母和数字的组合，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: A custom user ID or other identifier that can identify a specific user, such as a phone number or email address. We strongly recommend that you desensitize the value of this field in advance, for example, by hashing the value
parameters.help_zh: 您自定义的用户 ID，或者其他可以识别特定用户的标识，例如：手机号码、邮箱地址等。强烈建议对该字段的值进行预先脱敏，例如对值进行哈希处理
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en: The real name of the user. When Authorize='T' and the document type is a mainland China ID card, you must provide at least one of the following: key document information (DocName, DocNo) or document images (IdOcrPictureBase64/URL). Note: Supports a combination of Chinese characters with a minimum length of 1 character. No special characters are allowed, except for the middle dot (·) used in ethnic minority names
parameters.help_zh: 用户的真实姓名。当 Authorize='T'且证件类型为大陆身份证时，证件关键信息（DocName、DocNo）与证件图片（IdOcrPictureBase64/URL)必须至少输入其中一组 注：支持长度为 1 个汉字以上的汉字组合，无特殊字符，少数民族的点【·】除外
parameters.name: doc_name

parameters.help_en: The document number of the user. When Authorize='T' and the document type is a mainland China ID card, you must provide at least one of the following: key document information (DocName, DocNo) or document images (IdOcrPictureBase64/URL). Note: Supports a combination of letters and numbers with a length of 18 characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户的证件号。当 Authorize='T'且证件类型为大陆身份证时，证件关键信息（DocName、DocNo）与证件图片（IdOcrPictureBase64/URL)必须至少输入其中一组 注：支持长度为 18 位的字母和数字组合
parameters.name: doc_no

parameters.help_en: The URL of the front side of the identity document image
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded identity document image. Note:

If you choose this method to pass in the document image, check the photo size and do not pass in an excessively large photo.
Specify one of the following parameters: IdOcrPictureBase64, IdOcrPictureUrl, or IdOcrPictureFile
parameters.help_zh:
卡证图片 Base64 编码。 说明

如果您选择该方式传入证件图片，请检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片。
IdOcrPictureBase64 和 IdOcrPictureUrl 和 IdOcrPictureFile 三选一
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The file stream of the front side of the identity document image
parameters.help_zh: 证件正面图片 文件流
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_file

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face photo
parameters.name: face_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded face image.

Note:

If you choose this method to pass in the face image, check the photo size and do not pass in an excessively large photo.
Specify one of the following parameters: FacePictureBase64, FacePictureUrl, or FacePictureFile
parameters.help_zh:
人像图片 Base64 编码。

说明

如果您选择该方式传入证件图片，请检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片。
FacePictureBase64 和 FacePictureUrl 和 FacePictureFile 三选一
parameters.name: face_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The file stream of the face photo
parameters.name: face_picture_file

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether cropping is allowed. By default, cropping is not allowed. Valid values:

T: Detection is required.
F: Detection is required (default value: F)
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许裁剪，默认不允许，T/F

T：表示需要检测
F：表示需要检测（默认 F）
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable authoritative identity verification. Currently, this parameter applies only to second-generation mainland China ID cards
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启身份权威核验，目前仅适用于中国大陆二代身份证
parameters.name: authorize

parameters.help_en:
The custom OCR quality detection threshold mode. Valid values:

0: system default.
1: strict mode.
2: loose mode.
3 (default): quality detection disabled
parameters.help_zh:
自定义 OCR 质量检测阈值模式：

0：系统默认
1：严格模式
2：宽松模式
3（默认）：关闭质量检测
parameters.name: id_threshold

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable face quality detection
parameters.name: face_quality_check

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable document anti-spoofing
parameters.name: id_spoof

ExtIdInfo.description_en: The identity document recognition result. Returned only when the API response is successful
ExtIdInfo.description_zh: 卡证识别结果 只有当接口响应成功时返回

Passed.description_en: Indicates whether the verification passed. A value of Y indicates passed, and a value of N indicates not passed
Passed.description_zh: 是否通过，通过为 Y，不通过为 N

TransactionId.description_en: The unique identifier of the verification request
